findings.highlight: I picked it up when I almost got killed by Lancer at school.
findings.evidenceJa: 気が付いたら近くに落ちてたんで拾って、そのまま
findings.governingReading: He noticed it lying nearby, picked it up and kept it.

findings.highlight: You'll give me the wrong idea
findings.evidenceJa: どこかしらで誤解を招く
